# connect_to_browser

`connect_to_browser()` is used to start selenium webdriver service. You can use this function before using `download_csv_auto()` and `download_csv_schedule()`.

```{r function-connect_to_browser}
#' Start selenium webdriver service
#' 
#' @description
#'
#' `connect_to_browser()` is used to start the selenium webdriver service.
#' 
#' @param dest_dir The path of chrome browser dirver and selenium server.
#'
#' @return NULL
#' 
#' @importFrom wdauto "get_cd" "get_ss" "auto_cs"
#' @export
connect_to_browser <- function(dest_dir) {
  wdauto::get_cd(dest_dir)
  wdauto::get_ss(dest_dir)
  wdauto::auto_cs(dest_dir)
}
```

```{r examples-connect_to_browser}
connect_to_browser(dest_dir = "C:/Users/Dell/Desktop/test")
```

# download_csv_auto

`download_csv_auto()` can download pig performance test station CSVs from chrome browser.

```{=html}
<!-- 
This first section shows:

- the three parts necessary for a package: 'function', 'examples' and 'tests'.  
  + Note that the three following chunks have names accordingly.

-->
```
```{r function-download_csv_auto}
#' Automatically download CSVs
#' 
#' @description
#'
#' `download_csv_auto()` is used to download CSVs from chrome browser.
#' 
#' @param url The login url of pig performance test station website.
#' @param username The username of pig performance test station website.
#' @param password The password of pig performance test station website.
#' @param csv_position The position of the CSV report in the browser menu, as a numeric string.
#' @param location Numeric value in string format.
#' @param date A vector of Date values or YYYY-MM-DD strings.
#' @param download_path The folder of downloading csv files.
#'
#' @return Invisibly NULL. Writes CSVs to the download directory.
#' 
#' @export

download_csv_auto <- function(url, username, password, csv_position, location, date, download_path) {
  urls <- nedap_urls(url, username, password)
  validate_locations(csv_position, "csv_position", scalar = TRUE)
  validate_locations(location)
  date <- normalize_report_dates(date)
  download_path <- prepare_download_directory(download_path)
  staging <- tempfile(".pptsdd-", tmpdir = download_path)
  staging <- prepare_download_directory(staging)
  on.exit(unlink(staging, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)

  browser_opts <- get_browser_options(browser = "chrome", staging)
  remDr <- RSelenium::remoteDriver(
    browserName = browser_opts$browserName,
    extraCapabilities = browser_opts$options,
    remoteServerAddr = "127.0.0.1",
    port = 4444
  )
  utils::capture.output(remDr$open())
  on.exit(try(remDr$close(), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE, after = FALSE)
  remDr$setImplicitWaitTimeout(milliseconds = 10000)
  login_to_website(remDr, urls[["login"]], username, password)

  click_report <- function(location, date) {
    choose_item <- "/html/body/div[1]/div[1]/ul/li[4]/a"

    choose_ele <- remDr$findElement("xpath", choose_item)
    remDr$mouseMoveToLocation(webElement = choose_ele)
    remDr$click()

    download_item <- paste0("//*[@id=\"reports_page\"]/div[2]/div/div[3]/ol/li[",csv_position,"]/a")

    download_ele <- remDr$findElement("xpath", download_item)
    remDr$mouseMoveToLocation(webElement = download_ele)
    remDr$click()

    location_start <- "//*[@id=\"criteria\"]/report-selection-range/div/div/div/div[1]/input"
    location_end <- "//*[@id=\"criteria\"]/report-selection-range/div/div/div/div[2]/input"

    location_ele_start <- remDr$findElement("xpath", location_start)
    location_ele_end <- remDr$findElement("xpath", location_end)

    location_ele_start$clearElement()
    location_ele_end$clearElement()

    location_start_num <- list(location, key = "enter")

    location_ele_start$sendKeysToElement(location_start_num)

    location_ele_end$clickElement()

    date_start <- "//*[@id=\"datetimepicker0\"]/input"
    date_end <- "//*[@id=\"datetimepicker1\"]/input"

    date_ele_start <- remDr$findElement("xpath", date_start)
    date_ele_end <- remDr$findElement("xpath", date_end)

    date_ele_start$clearElement()

    date_need_to_download <- stringr::str_replace_all(date, "-", ".")

    date_start_num <- list(date_need_to_download, key = "enter")
    date_end_num <- list(date_need_to_download, key = "enter")

    date_ele_start$sendKeysToElement(date_start_num)
    date_ele_end$clearElement()
    date_ele_end$sendKeysToElement(date_end_num)

    download_button <- "//*[@id=\"reports_download_csv_data\"]/div[4]/button"

    download_button_ele <- remDr$findElement("xpath", download_button)
    remDr$mouseMoveToLocation(webElement = download_button_ele)
    remDr$click()
  }

  empty <- logical()
  for (day in unique(date)) {
    for (station in unique(location)) {
      result <- tryCatch({
        if (length(empty)) remDr$refresh()
        click_report(station, day)
        report <- wait_for_browser_csv(staging, station)
        stamp <- stringr::str_extract(basename(report), "(?<=_)\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}(?=_)")
        if (is.na(stamp)) stamp <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")
        save_report(report, download_path, station, day, download_date = stamp)
      }, error = identity)
      if (inherits(result, "error")) {
        report_summary(empty, paste0("Station ", station, ", ", day, ": ", conditionMessage(result)))
      }
      empty <- c(empty, result)
    }
  }
  report_summary(empty)
  invisible(NULL)
}

wait_for_browser_csv <- function(path, station, timeout = 120, poll_interval = 0.25) {
  deadline <- Sys.time() + timeout
  repeat {
    files <- list.files(path, all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    csv <- files[grepl("\\.csv$", files, ignore.case = TRUE)]
    if (length(csv) && !any(grepl("\\.crdownload$", files, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
      filename <- if (length(csv) == 1L) basename(csv) else ""
      if (!grepl(paste0("location", station, "([^0-9]|$)"), filename, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
        stop("The browser returned an unexpected or ambiguous CSV for station ", station, ".", call. = FALSE)
      }
      return(csv)
    }
    if (Sys.time() >= deadline) {
      stop("Timed out waiting for a completed CSV download.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    Sys.sleep(poll_interval)
  }
}

get_browser_options <- function(browser = "chrome", download_path) {
  # Check if the browser is 'chrome'
  if (browser != "chrome") {
    stop("Invalid browser specified. Use 'chrome'.") # Stop if it's not
  }

  download_path_temp <- normalizePath(download_path, winslash = "\\", mustWork = TRUE)

  # Create a list of chrome options
  browser_options <- list(
    chromeOptions = list(
      prefs = list(
        "download.default_directory" = download_path_temp, # Set default download directory
        "download.prompt_for_download" = FALSE,           # Don't prompt for download
        "download.directory_upgrade" = TRUE,               # Upgrade download directory
        "safebrowsing.enabled" = TRUE                      # Enable safe browsing
      )
    )
  )

  # Return the browser name and options as a list
  return(list(browserName = browser, options = browser_options))
}

# Function to login to a website using Selenium
login_to_website <- function(remDr, url, username, password) {
  remDr$navigate(url) # Navigate to the specified URL

  # Define XPaths for username and password input fields
  login_user <- "//*[@id=\"frmLogin\"]/div[2]/input"
  login_passwd <- "//*[@id=\"frmLogin\"]/div[3]/input"

  # Find the username and password elements using their XPaths
  login_user_ele <- remDr$findElement("xpath", login_user)
  login_passwd_ele <- remDr$findElement("xpath", login_passwd)

  # Define the username and password
  user <- list(username)
  pass <- list(password)

  # Send the username and password to their respective elements
  login_user_ele$sendKeysToElement(user)
  login_passwd_ele$sendKeysToElement(pass)

  # Define the XPath for the login button
  login <- "//*[@id=\"login_button\"]"

  # Find the login button element using its XPath
  login_ele <- remDr$findElement("xpath", login)

  # Move the mouse to the location of the login button
  remDr$mouseMoveToLocation(webElement = login_ele)

  # Click the login button
  remDr$click()
}
```

# download_csv_schedule

`download_csv_schedule()` is used to make download task. You can download the *Yesterday* data at certain time in every day.

```{r function-download_csv_schedule}
#' Schedule automatic downloads of CSVs
#' 
#' @description
#'
#' `download_csv_schedule()` is used to make download task.
#' 
#' @param taskname A character string with the name of the task. Should not contain any spaces.
#' @param schedule Either one of 'ONCE', 'MONTHLY', 'WEEKLY', 'DAILY', 'HOURLY', 'MINUTE', 'ONLOGON', 'ONIDLE.
#' @param starttime A time point in HH:MM format indicating when to run the script.
#' @param startdate A date that specifies the first date on which to run the task. Only applicable if schedule is of type 'MONTHLY', 'WEEKLY', 'DAILY', 'HOURLY', 'MINUTE'. Use the Windows task scheduler's date format for your locale.
#' @param rscript_args A named list of download arguments. Optionally set password_env to the name of the password environment variable (default password). The task account must provide the variable when the script runs.
#' @param ... Additional arguments passed to the Windows task scheduler.
#'
#' @return The output of the Windows task registration command.
#' @export

download_csv_schedule <- function(taskname, schedule, starttime, startdate, rscript_args = NULL, ...) {
  schedule_nedap_download("download_csv_auto", taskname, schedule, starttime, startdate, rscript_args, ...)
}
```

```{r examples-download_csv_schedule}
# Make a download task
download_csv_schedule(taskname = "ppt_csv_download",
                      schedule = "DAILY",
                      starttime = "20:00",
                      startdate = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y/%m/%d"),
                      rscript_args = list(url = Sys.getenv("url"),
                                          username = Sys.getenv("username"),
                                          password_env = "password",
                                          location = c("606","607"),
                                          csv_position = "1",
                                          download_path = "C:/Users/Dell/Downloads/download_temp"))
# Delete download task
taskscheduleR::taskscheduler_delete("ppt_csv_download")
# Reset selenium webdriver service
disconnect_from_browser()
```

# disconnect_from_browser

`disconnect_from_browser()` is used to reset selenium webdriver service. You can use this function after using `download_csv_auto()` and `download_csv_schedule()`.

```{r function-connect_to_browser}
#' Reset selenium webdriver service
#' 
#' @description
#'
#' `disconnect_from_browser()` is used to reset selenium webdriver service.
#'
#' @return NULL
#' 
#' @importFrom wdauto "reset_cs"
#' @export

disconnect_from_browser <- function() {
  wdauto::reset_cs()
}
```

# get_csv

```{r function-get_csv}
#' Direct web scraping CSVs
#' 
#' @description
#' 
#' `get_csv()` allows you to directly download CSV files from the web. You can download CSV data for a specific location range or date range. 
#'
#' @param url A character string specifying the URL to log into.
#' @param username A character string specifying the username for login.
#' @param password A character string specifying the password for login.
#' @param location_min A character string specifying the minimum location.
#' @param location_max A character string specifying the maximum location.
#' @param date_min The earliest date as a Date or YYYY-MM-DD string.
#' @param date_max The latest date as a Date or YYYY-MM-DD string.
#' @param download_path A character string specifying the path where the downloaded CSV file should be saved.
#' @param show_message A logical value. If TRUE, a message will be displayed after the download. Default is FALSE.
#'
#' @return CSVs in the path of download_path.
#' 
#' @export

get_csv <- function(url, username, password, location_min, location_max, date_min, date_max, download_path, show_message = FALSE) {
  date_min <- normalize_report_dates(date_min, "date_min", scalar = TRUE)
  date_max <- normalize_report_dates(date_max, "date_max", scalar = TRUE)
  validate_locations(location_min, "location_min", scalar = TRUE)
  validate_locations(location_max, "location_max", scalar = TRUE)
  if (date_min > date_max) {
    stop("date_min must be on or before date_max.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (as.numeric(location_min) > as.numeric(location_max)) {
    stop("location_min must be less than or equal to location_max.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  validate_show_message(show_message)
  download_path <- prepare_download_directory(download_path)

  cookie_file <- tempfile()
  on.exit(unlink(cookie_file), add = TRUE)
  report_request <- login_nedap(url, username, password, cookie_file)
  location <- if (location_min == location_max) location_min else paste(location_min, location_max, sep = "_")
  date <- if (date_min == date_max) date_min else paste(date_min, date_max, sep = "_")
  download_csv(report_request, location_min, location_max, date_min, date_max,
               download_path, location, date, show_message = show_message)
  invisible(NULL)
}

validate_text <- function(value, name) {
  if (!is.character(value) || length(value) != 1L || is.na(value) || !nzchar(trimws(value))) {
    stop(name, " must be a non-empty character string.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}

validate_locations <- function(value, name = "location", scalar = FALSE) {
  if (!is.character(value) || !length(value) || (scalar && length(value) != 1L) ||
      anyNA(value) || any(!grepl("^[0-9]+$", value)) ||
      any(!is.finite(as.numeric(value)))) {
    stop(name, " must contain numeric station IDs as character strings.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}

normalize_report_dates <- function(value, name = "date", scalar = FALSE) {
  invalid <- function() {
    stop(name, " must contain valid Date values or YYYY-MM-DD strings.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!length(value) || (scalar && length(value) != 1L)) invalid()
  if (inherits(value, "Date")) {
    if (any(!is.finite(as.numeric(value)))) invalid()
    value <- format(value, "%Y-%m-%d")
  }
  if (!is.character(value) || anyNA(value) || any(!grepl("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$", value))) {
    invalid()
  }
  parsed <- as.Date(value, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
  if (anyNA(parsed) || any(format(parsed, "%Y-%m-%d") != value)) invalid()
  value
}

validate_show_message <- function(show_message) {
  if (!is.logical(show_message) || length(show_message) != 1L || is.na(show_message)) {
    stop("show_message must be TRUE or FALSE.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}

prepare_download_directory <- function(path) {
  validate_text(path, "download_path")
  path <- path.expand(path)
  if (!dir.exists(path)) dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  if (!dir.exists(path)) stop("Cannot create download directory: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

nedap_urls <- function(url, username, password) {
  validate_text(url, "url")
  validate_text(username, "username")
  validate_text(password, "password")
  root <- sub("/+$", "", url)
  c(login = paste0(root, "/login/LoginPage.web"),
    report = paste0(root, "/pigperformancetesting/reports/DownloadCsvDataReport.web"))
}

login_nedap <- function(url, username, password, cookie_file) {
  urls <- nedap_urls(url, username, password)
  login_response <- httr2::request(urls[["login"]]) |>
    httr2::req_method("POST") |>
    httr2::req_body_form(select_username = username, input_password = password) |>
    httr2::req_cookie_preserve(cookie_file) |>
    httr2::req_timeout(60) |>
    httr2::req_perform()

  if (httr2::resp_status(login_response) != 200L ||
      grepl("<form\\b[^>]*frmLogin|<input\\b[^>]*name\\s*=\\s*['\"]?input_password",
            httr2::resp_body_string(login_response), ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE)) {
    stop("Nedap login failed. Check the account and website URL.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  # The existing report endpoint used POST. Keep that method and share only cookies.
  httr2::request(urls[["report"]]) |>
    httr2::req_method("POST") |>
    httr2::req_cookie_preserve(cookie_file) |>
    httr2::req_timeout(120) |>
    httr2::req_retry(max_tries = 3, is_transient = function(resp) {
      httr2::resp_status(resp) %in% c(429L, 500L, 503L)
    })
}

download_csv <- function(report_request, location_min, location_max, date_min, date_max,
                         download_path, location, date, archive = FALSE, show_message = FALSE) {
  response <- report_request |>
    httr2::req_url_query(
      generate = "1", location_min = location_min, location_max = location_max,
      date_min = paste0(date_min, "T00:00:00Z"), date_max = paste0(date_max, "T00:00:00Z")
    ) |>
    httr2::req_perform()

  content_type <- httr2::resp_header(response, "Content-Type")
  if (httr2::resp_status(response) != 200L ||
      (!is.null(content_type) && grepl("html|json|xml", content_type, ignore.case = TRUE))) {
    stop("Nedap did not return a CSV report. Check the session and report parameters.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  staged_file <- tempfile(".pptsdd-", tmpdir = download_path)
  on.exit(unlink(staged_file), add = TRUE)
  writeBin(httr2::resp_body_raw(response), staged_file)
  empty <- save_report(staged_file, download_path, location, date, archive = archive)
  if (show_message) message("Locations: ", location, " and dates: ", date, " downloaded")
  empty
}

report_is_empty <- function(path) {
  invalid <- function() {
    stop("The downloaded report is missing or is not a valid CSV.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  size <- file.size(path)
  if (is.na(size) || size == 0) invalid()
  connection <- file(path, open = "rt", encoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
  on.exit(close(connection), add = TRUE)

  repeat {
    header <- readLines(connection, n = 1L, warn = FALSE, skipNul = FALSE)
    if (!length(header)) invalid()
    header <- trimws(sub("^\ufeff", "", header))
    if (nzchar(header)) break
  }
  if (substring(header, 1L, 1L) %in% c("<", "{", "[")) invalid()

  separators <- c(",", ";", "\t")
  header_fields <- vapply(separators, function(separator) {
    header_connection <- textConnection(header)
    on.exit(close(header_connection))
    fields <- utils::count.fields(header_connection, sep = separator, quote = '"',
                                  comment.char = "")
    if (length(fields) == 1L && !is.na(fields)) fields else 0L
  }, integer(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  delimiter <- which.max(header_fields)
  if (header_fields[delimiter] < 2L) invalid()

  fields <- withCallingHandlers(
    utils::count.fields(path, sep = separators[delimiter], quote = '"', comment.char = ""),
    warning = function(warning) invalid()
  )
  if (!length(fields) || is.na(fields[length(fields)]) ||
      any(fields[!is.na(fields)] != header_fields[delimiter])) invalid()
  sum(!is.na(fields)) == 1L
}

save_report <- function(source, download_path, location, date, archive = TRUE,
                        download_date = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")) {
  empty <- report_is_empty(source)
  target_dir <- download_path
  if (archive) {
    category <- if (empty) "EmptyCSVs" else "NonEmptyCSVs"
    target_dir <- prepare_download_directory(file.path(download_path, category, location))
  }
  filename <- paste0("location", location, "_", date, "data_", download_date, "download.csv")
  target <- file.path(target_dir, filename)
  if (!suppressWarnings(file.rename(source, target))) {
    stop("Cannot move the downloaded CSV to ", target, ".", call. = FALSE)
  }
  empty
}

report_summary <- function(empty, failures = character()) {
  summary <- sprintf("Nedap CSVs: %d with data, %d empty, %d failed.",
                     sum(!empty), sum(empty), length(failures))
  if (length(failures)) stop(paste(c(summary, failures), collapse = "\n"), call. = FALSE)
  message(summary)
}
```

# get_csv_auto

```{r function-get_csv_auto}
#' Direct web scraping CSVs
#' 
#' @description
#' 
#' `get_csv_auto` allows you to directly download CSV files from the web. You can download CSV data for a specific location or date.
#'
#' @param url A character string specifying the URL to log into.
#' @param username A character string specifying the username for login.
#' @param password A character string specifying the password for login.
#' @param location A character vector of numeric station IDs.
#' @param date A vector of Date values or YYYY-MM-DD strings.
#' @param download_path A character string specifying the path where the downloaded CSV file should be saved.
#' @param show_message A logical value. If TRUE, a message will be displayed after the download. Default is FALSE.
#'
#' @return CSVs in the path of download_path.
#' 
#' @export

get_csv_auto <- function(url, username, password, location, date, download_path, show_message = FALSE) {
  validate_locations(location)
  date <- normalize_report_dates(date)
  validate_show_message(show_message)
  download_path <- prepare_download_directory(download_path)

  cookie_file <- tempfile()
  on.exit(unlink(cookie_file), add = TRUE)
  report_request <- login_nedap(url, username, password, cookie_file)

  empty <- logical()
  failures <- character()
  for (day in unique(date)) {
    for (station in unique(location)) {
      result <- tryCatch(
        download_csv(report_request, station, station, day, day, download_path,
                     station, day, archive = TRUE, show_message = show_message),
        error = identity
      )
      if (inherits(result, "error")) {
        failures <- c(failures, paste0("Station ", station, ", ", day, ": ", conditionMessage(result)))
      } else {
        empty <- c(empty, result)
      }
    }
  }
  report_summary(empty, failures)
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r examples-get_csv_auto}

             username = Sys.getenv("username"),
             password = Sys.getenv("password"),
             location = c("607","608"),
             date = c("2024-02-18", "2024-02-19"),
             download_path = "C:/Users/Dell/Downloads/download_rename")
```

```{r function-get_csv_schedule}
#' Schedule automatic downloads of CSVs
#' 
#' @description
#'
#' `get_csv_schedule()` is used to make download task.
#' 
#' @param taskname A character string with the name of the task. Should not contain any spaces.
#' @param schedule Either one of 'ONCE', 'MONTHLY', 'WEEKLY', 'DAILY', 'HOURLY', 'MINUTE', 'ONLOGON', 'ONIDLE.
#' @param starttime A time point in HH:MM format indicating when to run the script.
#' @param startdate A date that specifies the first date on which to run the task. Only applicable if schedule is of type 'MONTHLY', 'WEEKLY', 'DAILY', 'HOURLY', 'MINUTE'. Use the Windows task scheduler's date format for your locale.
#' @param rscript_args A named list of download arguments. Optionally set password_env to the name of the password environment variable (default password). The task account must provide the variable when the script runs.
#' @param ... Additional arguments passed to the Windows task scheduler.
#'
#' @return The output of the Windows task registration command.
#' @export

get_csv_schedule <- function(taskname, schedule, starttime, startdate, rscript_args = NULL, ...) {
  schedule_nedap_download("get_csv_auto", taskname, schedule, starttime, startdate, rscript_args, ...)
}

schedule_nedap_download <- function(downloader, taskname, schedule, starttime, startdate, rscript_args, ...) {
  validate_text(taskname, "taskname")
  validate_text(schedule, "schedule")
  validate_text(starttime, "starttime")
  validate_text(startdate, "startdate")
  if (!grepl("^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$", starttime)) {
    stop("starttime must be a valid HH:MM time.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if (!grepl("^[0-9]+([./-][0-9]+){2}$", startdate)) {
    stop("startdate must be a numeric date in the Windows task scheduler's locale format.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  lines <- scheduled_download_script(downloader, rscript_args)
  directory <- prepare_download_directory("C:/Temp/pptsdd")
  script <- tempfile("task-", tmpdir = directory, fileext = ".R")
  registered <- FALSE
  on.exit(if (!registered) unlink(script), add = TRUE)
  writeLines(lines, script, useBytes = TRUE)

  result <- taskscheduleR::taskscheduler_create(
    taskname = taskname, rscript = script, schedule = schedule, starttime = starttime,
    startdate = startdate, rscript_args = NULL, ...
  )
  status <- attr(result, "status", exact = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(status) && status != 0L) {
    stop("Windows could not register task ", taskname, ".", call. = FALSE)
  }
  registered <- TRUE
  result
}

scheduled_download_script <- function(downloader, args) {
  required <- c("url", "username", "location", "download_path")
  if (downloader == "download_csv_auto") required <- c(required, "csv_position")
  optional <- c("password", "password_env")
  if (downloader == "get_csv_auto") optional <- c(optional, "show_message")

  if (!is.list(args) || !all(required %in% names(args)) || anyDuplicated(names(args)) ||
      length(setdiff(names(args), c(required, optional))) ||
      length(names(args)) != length(args)) {
    stop("rscript_args must be a named list with ", paste(required, collapse = ", "),
         " and supported optional arguments.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  password_env <- if ("password_env" %in% names(args)) args[["password_env"]] else "password"
  validate_text(password_env, "password_env")
  if (!grepl("^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$", password_env)) {
    stop("password_env must be an environment variable name.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  if ("password" %in% names(args) &&
      !identical(args[["password"]], Sys.getenv(password_env, unset = ""))) {
    stop("Set the task account's password environment variable and supply password_env instead of a literal password.",
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  args[["password"]] <- NULL
  args[["password_env"]] <- NULL

  validate_text(args[["url"]], "url")
  validate_text(args[["username"]], "username")
  validate_locations(args[["location"]])
  if (downloader == "download_csv_auto") {
    validate_locations(args[["csv_position"]], "csv_position", scalar = TRUE)
  }
  if ("show_message" %in% names(args)) validate_show_message(args[["show_message"]])
  args[["download_path"]] <- prepare_download_directory(args[["download_path"]])

  c("arg_list <-", utils::capture.output(dput(args)),
    paste0("password_env <- ", encodeString(password_env, quote = '"')),
    'arg_list$password <- Sys.getenv(password_env, unset = "")',
    'if (!nzchar(arg_list$password)) stop("Set the password environment variable for the scheduled account: ", password_env, call. = FALSE)',
    'arg_list$date <- Sys.Date() - 1L',
    paste0("do.call(pptsdd::", downloader, ", arg_list)"))
}
```

```{r examples-get_csv_schedule}
# Make a download task
get_csv_schedule(taskname = "ppt_csv_download",
                 schedule = "DAILY",
                 starttime = "20:00",
                 startdate = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y/%m/%d"),
                 rscript_args = list(url = Sys.getenv("url"),
                                     username = Sys.getenv("username"),
                                     password_env = "password",
                                     location = c("606","607"),
                                     download_path = "C:/Users/Dell/Downloads/download_rename"))
# Delete download task
taskscheduleR::taskscheduler_delete("ppt_csv_download")
# Reset selenium webdriver service
disconnect_from_browser()
```
